_meta.name: Google AI (Gemini)
_meta.billing: Generous free tier, then pay-as-you-go. Often the cheapest premium option.
_meta.notes: Gemini 2.5 Pro has a 1M token context window — perfect for ingesting whole APKs, large firmware blobs, or session logs.

recommended._meta: Gemini 2.5 Pro is the long-context RE champion. Flash is fast and cheap.
